messages:
incident-bot: PAGER  Critical: Sustained 5xx surge and p99 >4s on Dedicated VPC pool 'orion-vpc-pool-2' impacting tenant helios-inc (enterprise). Pager: @kai-oncall. See: https://internal.incidents/1902003004

kai-oncall: Ack. seeing p99 ~4.5s and 5xx spike starting 16:10 UTC. Marking urgent due to enterprise SLA. Pulling node-level logs and allocation traces.

reena-sre: I'm seeing Kernel OOM kills on host vnode-09 around 16:096:11. Runtime logs show repeated large context pin ops and then cgroup memory pressure. Possibly a runaway session from co-located tenant 'forge-analytics'.

oscar-eng: Checking recent control plane changes: @deploy-bot any config changes to pool in last 48h?

deploy-bot: Recent changes for orion-vpc-pool-2: 2026-04-28 21:41 increase: per_pool.concurrent_sessions from 120 -> 180 (change-id: cfg-8f3a), 2026-05-02 04:02 network route update (no deploy). No model rollouts in past 72h.

reena-sre: That concurrent_sessions bump could have allowed more long-lived sessions to accumulate; combined with a tenant sending 100k+ token sequences could trigger cgroup OOM.

kai-oncall: propose mitigations: 1) cap per-tenant sessions for the pool 2) throttle the offending tenant 'forge-analytics' 3) move helios-inc to their reserved fallback slice (helios-reserved-1) 4) restart runtime on affected host. I'll run steps 1-3 now.

oscar-eng: executing tenant cap:```curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/pools/orion-vpc-pool-2/config -d '{"per_tenant.max_sessions":8}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'``` applied.

reena-sre: throttling forge-analytics:```./tenant_ctl --pool orion-vpc-pool-2 --tenant forge-analytics --action throttle --limit 5rps --duration 30m``` throttle active; forge qlen dropped ~70%.

kai-oncall: initiating traffic migration for helios-inc to reserved slice:```./traffic_shift --tenant helios-inc --from orion-vpc-pool-2 --to helios-reserved-1 --strategy gradual --step 20 --interval 20s --dry-run false``` migration started; currently 40% shifted.

monitoring-bot: Metric update: p99 latency trending down to 1.2s; 5xx rate decreased 78% since throttle + migration. Recommend 45m watch.

oscar-eng: restarting runtime on vnode-09 to clear OOM state:```ssh vnode-09 sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime``` restart completed, healthchecks OK.

lucy-csm: looping in Helios contact @helios-eng: short customer-safe note needed: we've detected resource contention in your shared pool, moved your traffic to a reserved slice and are stabilizing. We'll follow up with RCA and credit proposal. Any immediate questions?

helios-eng: We're seeing partial failures in production and some batch jobs queued. Appreciate the quick action. Please confirm whether any data was retried or dropped. We'll need a timeline and impact numbers for our internal compliance.

reena-sre: quick impact snapshot from sampling: error window 16:09-16:20 UTC; ~9% of helios requests returned 5xx; estimated affected tokens ~95k. We'll export full logs for accuracy.

lucy-csm: preliminary credit calc: ~95k tokens -> est $950 (prelim). We'll confirm after full logs.

sla-manager: Note: Helios is under enterprise contract 99.95% uptime. If verified impact meets criteria, a pro-rated credit will be issued. I'll coordinate with billing.

oscar-eng: RCA draft notes: - Root cause: pool concurrency increase allowed accumulation of long sessions; a co-tenant sent extensive long-context sequences causing cgroup memory exhaustion on vnode-09. - Contributing factors: no per-tenant session caps in config change, lack of cgroup-level early alerts for session growth, no auto-failover policy for enterprise tenants in shared pools. - Mitigations performed: applied per-tenant cap, throttled offending tenant, migrated helios to reserved slice, restarted runtime host. - Long-term actions: implement change-gate for per-pool concurrency increases, add per-tenant long-sequence telemetry & alerting, implement auto-shift to reserved slice for SLA-tiered tenants, and add cgroup oom early-warning.

kai-oncall: handed off to reena-sre for RCA write-up and to lucy-csm for customer comms. I'll remain on-call for 1.5h for any escalations. Marking incident contained at 16:27 UTC; monitoring 1h.

monitoring-bot: Incident contained: 5xxs below threshold and latency within SLO. 1h elevated watch active.

lucy-csm: customer comms plan: - send ops-safe note to Helios within 60 minutes - escalate exec one-pager for AE + CRO within 3 hours with proposed credit - schedule 1:1 technical deep dive with Helios infra this week - deliver full RCA and credit calc within 72 hours. I'll draft and circulate for review.

sla-manager: opened INC-1902003004 in post-incident tracker and assigned tasks: export request logs, verify token counts, confirm credit amount, prepare exec summary.

reena-sre: follow-ups for eng: 1) add preflight check & approval for per-pool concurrency increases 2) add per-tenant session growth alert + automated throttling action 3) add reserve-slice auto-migration policy for SLA tenants 4) infra: cgroup-level memory warning & proactive shard restart. I'll open PRs and include ETA in RCA.

lucy-csm: drafting customer note now. Suggested non-technical line: "We identified resource contention in the shared pool hosting your workload and moved your traffic to an isolated reserved slice to restore performance. We apologize for the disruption and will provide a full RCA and credit proposal shortly." Approve?

helios-eng: that's fine. Please include exact timing and affected percentage when available. Also include steps you're taking so we can update our execs.

kai-oncall: closing active pager. (:white_check_mark:)
__notes: Slack thread JSON for incident coordination and post-incident customer follow-up. Conforms to agents.md: single-number filename, messages are a single continuous string with sender prefixes; metadata included.
